talking_points: **Network adequacy:** 118 solo PCPs winding down in Michigan; 20 ZIP(s) have 2+ at once (Sterling Heights 48310, Southfield 48034, Lapeer 48446) — each a ~12-month drive-time compliance gap.
**Facility-fee shield:** ~13,902 Medicare patients at risk. In hospital clinics they cost 2-3x more (facility fees); Corner NPs hold them at 85-95% of physician rates.
**Auto-assignment:** thinnest-supply counties (Menominee County) — where unattributed members and HEDIS gaps concentrate. Prime for auto-assignment or co-funded outreach.
**Ask:** fast-track Corner credentialing. 17 Tier-A practice(s) are top priority; ~301,200 patients across 251 at-risk practices statewide.
